flags.message: The event declares moment distribution, but frozen context and snapshot show zero petition distributions. The July 22 distribution and October 5 grant concern sealing motion 26M8, not certiorari. I retain distribution_count=0 and predict the petition from this pre-distribution posture; relist-increment=0.97 prices a first petition distribution under the literal count-increment contract, not a true second-conference relist. Please inspect moment selection without treating the ancillary motion grant as the petition outcome.

No filed-document texts were provisioned. I retrieved the snapshot-linked petition and public appendix; the latter contains only the rehearing-denial order, not the lower merits opinions. CourtListener MCP returned HTTP 429 on a date-bounded lower-opinion search. The forecast therefore relies on petition advocacy without the lower courts' full reasoning or a BIO; the response deadline remains in the future.
